sn55.40:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2.
sn55.40:1.2: Atha kho Nandiyo sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Nandiyo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn55.40:1.3: Yasseva nu kho bhante ariyasāvakassa cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni || sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi so evaṃ nu kho bhante ariyasāvako Pamādavihārī ti vuccati || ||
sn55.40:2.1: Yassa kho Nandiya cattāri sotāpattiyaṅgāni sabbena sabbam sabbathā sabbaṃ natthi tam aham Bāhiro puthujjanapakkhe ṭhito ti vadāmi || || 4.
sn55.40:2.2: Api ca Nandiya yathā ariyasāvako pamādavihārī ceva hoti appamādavihārī ca
sn55.40:2.3: taṃ suṇāhi sādhukam manasi karohi bhāsissāmī ti || ||
sn55.40:2.4: Evam bhante ti kho Nandiyo sakko Bhagavato paccassosi || ||
sn55.40:3.2: Idha Nandiya ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.40:3.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddo bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.40:3.4: So tena buddhe aveccappasādena santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattim paṭisallānāya ||
sn55.40:3.5: tassa evam pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti ||
sn55.40:3.11: dhammānam apātubhāvā Pamādavihārī teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn55.40:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ Nandiya ariyasāvako Dhamme ||
sn55.40:4.3: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.40:4.4: So tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi santuṭṭho na uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattim paṭisallāṇāya ||
sn55.40:4.5: tassa evam pamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ na hoti ||
sn55.40:4.11: dhammānam apātubhāvā Pamādavihārī teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn55.40:4.12: Evaṃ kho Nandiya ariyasāvako pamādavihārī hoti || || 6.
sn55.40:5.2: Idha Nandiya ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.40:5.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.40:5.4: So tena Buddhe aveccappasādena asantuṭṭho uttarim vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattim paṭisallāṇāya ||
sn55.40:5.5: tassa evam appamattassa viharato pāmujjam jāyati ||
sn55.40:5.11: dhammānam pātubhāvā Appamādavihārī teva saṅkhaṃ gacchati || ||
sn55.40:6.1: Puna ca param Nandiya ariyasāvako Dhamme ||
sn55.40:6.3: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.40:6.4: So tehi ariyakantehi sīlehi asantuṭṭho uttariṃ vāyamati divā pavivekāya rattim patisallāṇāya ||
sn55.40:6.5: tassa evam appamattassa viharato pāmujjaṃ jāyati ||
sn55.40:6.11: dhammānam pātubhāvā Appamādavihārī teva saṅkham gacchati || ||
sn55.40:6.12: Evaṃ kho Nandiya ariyasāvako appamādavihārī hotī ti || ||
sn55.40:7.4: Vassaṃ Kāḷī ca Nandiyā ti || || 2. Cattāro me
